note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(环保主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: When Lin moved to a town covered in smog, she could hardly see the hills nearby and often felt unwell. Instead of complaining, she joined a green group that planted trees and asked neighbours to burn less coal. A few years later, the air was clear again, and Lin felt proud that her small actions had helped her whole community breathe more easily.

questions.q: What did Lin do instead of complaining about the smog?
options: She took part in tree planting and urged neighbours to use less coal.
She moved away from the town at once.
She kept all her windows tightly closed.
She did nothing and waited for help.
questions.explanation: 原文 'joined a green group that planted trees and asked neighbours to burn less coal' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Lin feel a few years later?
options: Proud that her actions helped her community breathe more easily.
Sorry that she had ever helped.
Worried that the smog was getting worse.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud that her small actions had helped her whole community breathe more easily'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
